about.title: Building Better Apps with Better Experiences
description: I am a mobile application engineer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with a deep focus on crafting high-performance, responsive Flutter applications.

Over the course of my career, I have architected and deployed production mobile applications ranging from enterprise Point-of-Sale (POS) and inventory systems to FinTech investment platforms, personal finance management apps, and educational tools.
I believe in building resilient software with offline-first capabilities, clean architecture, and intuitive user experiences that perform reliably in any environment.

philosophyPoints.title: Offline-First Reliability
philosophyPoints.description: Local storage and synchronization ensure uninterrupted workflows even with weak or dropped connections.

philosophyPoints.title: Clean Architecture
philosophyPoints.description: Decoupled domain logic and UI layer separation ensure maintainability and testability.

philosophyPoints.title: Performance Focused
philosophyPoints.description: Optimized widget rendering, background isolates, and memory management for silky 60/120 FPS.

featuredProjects.title: Tijarah
featuredProjects.subtitle: A POS and Inventory Management System for Small and Medium Businesses
featuredProjects.shortDescription: Comprehensive point-of-sale solution with real-time inventory tracking, sales analytics, purchase orders, offline-first sync, invoice generation, expense management, and multi-location support for retail businesses.
featuredProjects.overview: Tijarah is a point-of-sale and inventory system designed for retail stores and businesses, featuring full offline-first functionality, receipt printing, and stock management.
featuredProjects.problem: Unstable network connections frequently disrupt sales and point-of-sale checkouts in retail stores.
featuredProjects.solution: Built an offline-first transactional engine using local SQLite/Drift with background queue sync upon reconnection.
keyFeatures: Recycle Bin for Safe Record Recovery

Local persistence with SQLite and Drift reactive queries
